### Safe Internet survives closing the window
Closing the Kahf Guard window could remove the Safe Internet filter from the Mac. Home then reported protection as off and offered to set up something you had already set up, and until you did, nothing was filtering. The filter now stays exactly where you put it, and a failed save no longer takes it with it.
### Kahf Browser is protected like every other browser
Blocking did nothing at all in Kahf Browser — no blocked sites, no Shorts or Reels, no Telegram or WhatsApp guards, no website time limits. It was simply not recognised as a browser. It now gets the same protection Safari, Chrome, Brave and Firefox get.
### A guard you switch on looks switched on
Turning on YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels or any of the other guards moved the switch back to off, as though the Mac had refused you. It had not: the guard was already running, and closing and reopening the card showed it on. The switch now stays where you put it.
